site.name: FinTest Guide
site.tagline: Software testing, standards and regulation guide for banking and fintech
site.metaDescription: A guide to software testing types, standards, regulations and testing approach for banks and fintech companies.
site.partnerSummary: RabbitQA is a testing and quality platform that runs the quality process of banks and fintechs, from requirements to production, with AI-assisted agents. It is delivered together with the Virgosol team’s hands-on testing experience in banking projects.
site.clientNote: Akbank AG, operating in Germany, is an example of an institution that runs Mambu as its digital banking platform.

ddos.name: DDoSphere
ddos.summary: A cloud-based DDoS testing platform. It generates SYN/ACK/UDP/ICMP and HTTP(S) GET/POST flood scenarios from multiple geographic locations at defined severity levels in a controlled way, monitors the test live, reports the results and makes resilience comparable with its DRR score.

performance.name: RabbitQA Loadmance
performance.summary: Builds load scenarios for web channels and APIs: an HTTP scenario builder, JMeter and Postman import, virtual-user ramp-up plans and scheduled runs. It makes response times, error rates and capacity limits visible.

automation.name: RabbitQA AutoRunner
automation.summary: Runs web, mobile, API, desktop and POS automation from one place. It works with existing frameworks such as Gauge, Cucumber, Postman, Robot, JUnit and TestNG, and offers scheduled and CI-triggered runs, flaky-test tracking and team-approved self-healing. Its AI agent can generate scenarios from a goal written in plain language.

mobilehub.name: RabbitQA MobileHub
mobilehub.summary: Gives remote, browser-based access to real iOS and Android devices. Network traffic, device performance and accessibility checks sit on the same screen during live sessions, and every session is kept as a recording and a report.

analyzer.name: RabbitQA Analyzer
analyzer.summary: Scores requirement documents for ambiguity, completeness and testability, surfaces gaps before development starts and gives test coverage a measurable foundation.

accessibility.name: RabbitQA Accessibility Testing
accessibility.summary: Audits bank websites and mobile apps against WCAG 2.2: automated scans, batch runs, findings with element screenshots, AI-assisted fix suggestions and export to your issue tracker. Automated checks are completed by expert review with screen readers.

corebanking.name: Core Banking Testing Expertise
corebanking.summary: Parametric product, integration, migration and regression testing on Mambu- and Fimple-based digital banking platforms. Our team has testing experience in live banking projects running on Mambu.

home.eyebrow: Testing & quality guide for banking and fintech
home.title: In banking, quality is compliance.
home.lead: Which test types are needed and why, what each standard asks for, and which testing approach to follow: an impartial, practical reference for IT leaders, QA teams and compliance functions.
home.searchHintAfter: to find what you need quickly.
home.whyTitle: Why are quality and compliance so critical?

why.title: Outages hit customers directly
why.text: Mobile and internet banking is the only touchpoint with the bank for most customers. A slow payment screen or an unavailable channel is an operational, reputational and regulatory incident at the same time.

why.title: Compliance is shown through test evidence
why.text: Regulations such as DORA, BDDK and PCI DSS expect resilience and security to be tested regularly and the results documented. The testing process is the source of the evidence presented in an audit.

why.title: The pace of change is increasing
why.text: Open banking APIs, cloud-based core banking platforms and frequent release cycles make every safe release dependent on a systematic testing approach.

home.testsLead: Every test type follows the same template: why it is critical, which risk it prevents, which regulations it relates to and how to apply it.
home.regsLead: Scope, expectations and the test types that verify them.
home.matrixLead: Which regulation puts which testing activity in focus? Links in the cells take you to the relevant guide.
home.ctaTitle: Request a meeting on regulatory compliance testing
home.ctaText: PSD2, DORA, BDDK, WCAG 2.2 or core banking testing: review your organisation’s needs together with {{partner}} specialists.

partner.coreTitle: Core banking experience: Mambu and Fimple
partner.mambuText: A cloud-native, API-first SaaS banking platform. Products are defined through configuration rather than code and the platform is released frequently, which makes parametric product testing and continuous regression critical. Our team has testing experience in live banking projects running on Mambu.
partner.fimpleText: A cloud-based digital banking platform originating in Türkiye. Because of its modular design, integration, configuration and upgrade testing sit at the centre of the quality process for institutions that use it.
